hooks.command: jq -c 'if .agent_type == "router" and .tool_name == "Bash" then ((.tool_input.command // "") | gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$"; "")) as $c | if ($c | test("[;&|<>$`()\\\\\\n\\r]")) or ($c | test("--output")) or (($c | test("^scripts/router-worker")) and ($c | test("\\.\\."))) or (($c | test("^(git (status|log|diff|show)( .*)?|git branch (-v|-vv|-a|-av|-va|-a -v|--all|--all -v)|gh pr (view|list|status)( .*)?|ps (aux|-ef)|scripts/router-worker\\.sh (spawn|resume) [A-Za-z0-9._/ -]+)$")) | not) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "router Bash whitelist: git status/log/diff/show, git branch -v/-a, gh pr view/list/status, ps aux/-ef, and scripts/router-worker.sh spawn|resume only (single command, no pipes/redirects/substitution). Delegate anything else to a worker."}} else empty end else empty end '
